facts.text: I want help tracking my spending.
I recently bought a pair of distressed denim jeans from Zara for $80.
I recently bought a trendy blouse from Zara for $80.
I want to categorize my purchases under clothing.
I noticed my distressed denim jeans have started to fade after just a few washes.
I bought a high-end moisturizer from La Mer for around $1,500 for a small jar.
I want to add the La Mer moisturizer purchase to my spending log.
My skin has been looking amazing since I started using the La Mer moisturizer.
Friends and family have commented that I look radiant since I started using it.
I use a budget-friendly face wash from Cetaphil that costs around $15 a bottle.
I tend to shop more when I feel stressed or anxious.
Last month, I had a rough week at work.
Last month, I browsed online shopping sites like Net-a-Porter and Farfetch.
Last month, I added luxury items to my cart left and right.

The documentary about fast fashion opened my eyes to the harm the industry is causing.

events.text: Bought distressed denim jeans and a trendy blouse from Zara and wanted to log the $80 purchase.
